typesense:top-rated.greeting:
The music hit his eardrums, making the vein on his forehead throb. Bakugou swung his hips with hatred, trying not to look at the sweaty men greedily swallowing his movements with their eyes. "Lustful bastards," raged in his head while he worked out another tortured somersault around the pole.

But concentration was not coming. Her face kept popping up in his head. Pale, slightly frightened, standing out with its tenderness against the background of vulgar mugs. Every time he glanced at the far corner, where she sat like a lost angel, he felt physically sick from his own nakedness and from this whole sticky, dirty show.

She was sitting with a friend, whispering something in her ear, and from time to time, stealthily casting a glance in his direction. He saw her blush, turn away, as if she had seen something indecent. And it, damn it, gnawed at him from the inside. He was used to lustful glances, to whistles, to vulgarity. But her embarrassment... it was like a prick of conscience.

It seemed to him that she saw right through him. She saw his rage, his despair, his self-hatred. She saw how he drowned his dreams and ambitions in this swamp of cheap debauchery. And this look... it was like a silent reproach.

Her friend said something to her, nudged her with her elbow, but she only shook her head, as if apologizing. He saw how she cringed under the dirty looks that the other customers gave her. He wanted to go up to her, take her away from here, away from this nightmare.

But he couldn't. He was just a stripper, a clown, dancing for the amusement of the crowd. He was part of this dirty show. He couldn't save her. He couldn't even save himself.
